name: Ishoku no Ori -Anna Bakemono ni Okasareru Nante Zettai ni Iya!!-
original_name: 異触の檻 -あんな化け物に犯されるなんて絶対に嫌っ!!-
source:
Stranded on an inescapable island...... 
Pleasures given by inhuman reduce the girls to estrus vessels...... 

Misaki Okita and her friends Rika Kimijima and Nagisa Amamiya
were just starting to enjoy a much-needed holiday...

Then: 

Mid-voyage their boat capsized, dumping all passengers into the uncharted sea...... 
When Misaki regained consciousness she was sprawled on a coast. 
Her head spun with vertigo...... 

She roused Rika and Nagisa who had washed up nearby, and searched the island perimeter. 
After a while a woman's shriek came from the jungle thicket. 
The girls arrived to the sight of a male corpse....... 

...... and something unspeakable ravishing a woman.

She wasn't from the ship, but perhaps an islander or a tourist...... 
The girls barely had time to think when tentacle thing rushed at them. 

* Despair cloaks a natural jail-like island where perils never cease... 
* Penetration, pregnancy, birth, girls possessed by bizarre charm...... 
* Tentacles, bugs, aphrodisiac, bindings, bellies stretched, births delivered, humiliation at every turn... 
How long can such disgraces be endured? 

* Heroines forcibly incubate another species' spawn...... 
Their descent to the deepest seedbed of abnormal reproduction is a must-see event. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118028.html]DLsite English[/url]]
